declared difference (truth fix T1, code view): the awk cut each line at its first "//" (inside a string too) and read
block comments, strings and template literals as code, so a commented or quoted location.reload() counted as recovery
(A, B), a commented catch made a poll the flagged shape (C), a catch after "http://" was hidden (D), and a template
quoting setInterval(poll, ...) was taken for the poll call (E). The lint reads code only now (jssrc.Code; for .html,
the <script> contents only, jssrc.HTMLScripts).
